response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
), counts AS (
  SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist
), fractions AS (
  SELECT translink, ordertypedist, record_count,
         record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction
  FROM counts
)
SELECT translink, ordertypedist, record_count, fraction
FROM fractions
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each qualifying advancedbehavior record is counted once for its matching transaction record; the foreign key means there can be at most one match per record.
